ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback. We are so sorry to hear you are experiencing flare ups. 

We are happy to help you with this. Flare ups are a byproduct of grilling over live fire. The drippings falling down create the flare ups. While they can never be eliminated completely, below are some steps for reducing them:

1. Cleaning your grill. we recommend cleaning your cooking grates, Flavorizer bars, burner tubes, heat deflectors (if applicable), the inside of your cookbox, and your slide out grease tray.

2. If using a marinade, get as much excess liquid off as possible before putting the food on the grill.

3. If using a sauce, wait until the last 5-10 minutes to apply.

Be sure to check out the Weber blog for grilling guides, tips, videos, and recipes.

Our Care team will be reaching out to follow up. Thanks and happy grilling!

This may be the best grill ever! 

Bought this unassembled and took about an hour to put together. One ding in the door and Weber send me a new one in a few days.

Perfect for 2-3 people. Easily heats up for delicious burgers and roars to 500 degrees for sizzling steaks. 

The foldable side tables are something I thought I really wouldn't care about, but really make a difference. I have a small patio and flipping the tables down after grilling makes it easier to set the grill to the side until next time.

Can you find a cheaper grill? Of course you can. Can you find a better grill? I don't think so.
